[[AS Monaco FC|AS Monaco]] won the '''1977–78 Division 1 season''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 53 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1978/1979|Division 1 season 1978/1979]]
* [[Lille Olympique Sporting Club Lille Métropole|Lille]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[Angers SCO]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Paris FC]]: Third place, winner of barrages against [[RC Lens]]
